R-31.observed: From a GCP VM on another network, an app that obtained a limited key through MCP OAuth consent on the portal called blueprint:submit on the hosted workspace through https://app.papercusp.com/api/workspaces/ws-2802cefffb052f989eae2969/mcp and got a handle (receipt 6, work item WI-6); a replay with the same requestKey returned the same handle, and blueprint:status read the operation back through the portal. The same key was refused a tool outside its scope (work_items:list), and calls with no key or a bad key were refused with 401.
